rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for a person, life, or activity lacking a clear aim.

example.english: I stay home all day on my days off, and I’m really aimless.
example.traditional: 我放假成日留喺屋企，真係冇目標。
example.jyutping: ngo5 fong3 gaa3 seng4 jat6 lau4 hai2 uk1 kei2 zan1 hai6 mou5 muk6 biu1

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on lacking direction or a clear path rather than lacking a specific goal.

example.english: After graduation, I still haven’t figured out which path to take, so I feel aimless.
example.traditional: 畢業之後我仲未諗到行邊條路，覺得自己冇方向。
example.jyutping: bat1 jip6 zi1 hau6 ngo5 zung6 mei6 nam2 dou3 haang4 bin1 tiu4 lou6 gok3 dak1 zi6 gei2 mou5 fong1 hoeng3

rows.note: Use this more formal expression, especially in writing, when something is proceeding without purpose or direction.

example.english: They wandered around the streets, aimless and unsure where to go.
example.traditional: 佢哋漫無目的咁喺街上游蕩。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 maan6 mou4 muk6 dik1 gam3 hai2 gaai1 soeng6 jau4 dong6
